name: smwmusic-warioware-touched-number-cruncher
title: WarioWare: Touched! - Number Cruncher
description:
Also plays in Chalk Full and Free Range (and maybe others).

A short and peppy microgame theme from WarioWare: Touched!

Due to its short length, it's probably best suited for cutscenes or something. Includes an option to disable the loop.
